english.title: Use a motor vehicle on a road in a manner as to cause excessive noise
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in such a manner as to cause excessive noise which could have been avoided by the exercise of reasonable care on the part of the driver
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 97 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use on a road a motor vehicle
in such a manner as to cause excessive noise
which could be avoided by the exercise
of reasonable care on the part of the driver.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording. Provide additional information in the Statement of Facts if possible to indicate the scale of the noise together with details of its cause if appropriate.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H176 and H178.
(iii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) in such a way that there was an excessive noise.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
